annexes.quote: End Client: Rheinwerk Analytics GmbH, Munich, Germany (AtliQ project: Rheinwerk Insight data pipeline modernisation, Contract No. RWA-2026-014). Services: Cleansing, labelling and annotation of machine-sensor time-series data and maintenance records exported from the End Client's Rheinwerk Insight platform, to populate the cleansed and curated data layers and data quality framework of the End Client project (Milestone M3), including training and validation datasets for the End Client's predictive-maintenance models. Source data comprises vibration, temperature and pressure sensor streams from End Client customer plants, together with maintenance work orders and technician logs (including technician names, shift identifiers and free-text notes). Vendor Personnel shall access data via AtliQ-provisioned cloud workspaces and Vendor's own labelling platform.
